verses.text_uthmani: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ

translations.text: By the fig and the olive

verses.text_uthmani: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Laqad khalaqnal insaana fee ahsani taqweem

translations.text: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;

verses.transliteration: Thumma ra dad naahu asfala saafileen

translations.text: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Ill-lal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati; falahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon

translations.text: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.

verses.transliteration: Fama yu kaz zibuka b'adu bid deen

translations.text: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
Is not Allah the most just of judges?
